Crossword Puzzle

A real hand-built 9×9 crossword — 19 interlocking answers, across/down clues, check and reveal.

📖 How to use

  1. Click a clue (or a square) to select a word.
  2. Type letters — the cursor advances automatically.
  3. Use Check to flag mistakes, Reveal to fill the grid.
  4. Complete all 19 answers to finish the puzzle.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I fill in answers?

Click any clue to jump to its word, or click any square. Typing fills the letter and moves to the next square; arrow keys move around; Backspace deletes and steps back.

What's the difference between Check and Reveal?

“Check” marks every wrong letter in red without revealing answers. “Reveal” fills the whole grid — use it when you're truly stuck.

Is this a real crossword?

Yes — every word in this puzzle was hand-placed so that all 19 answers interlock like a newspaper crossword.
